name: ai-operator-os
description: A local-first operating system for AI-powered businesses.

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k "vite build --watch --configLoader runner" "vite preview --configLoader runner --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build && concurrently -k -n BUILD,WEB,ELECTRON -c green,cyan,magenta "vite build --watch --configLoader runner" "vite preview --configLoader runner --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173/ && electron ."
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:installer: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --config electron-builder.json
